dct_description_sm: Objective: Monitor water quality within the McIntosh Run watershed to evaluate environmental health for the protection of aquatic life, recreation, and aesthetics. Our current aims for the MRWA WQMP are to 1) screen for and identify specific pollutants of concern within the watershed (if any), and 2) track temporal water quality trends.
dct_title_s: McIntosh Run Watershed Association (MRWA) Water Quality Monitoring Program
